/og/math.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Three · The Math: “The math of staying together”. Both separation scenarios, costed against official figures. $5,100, per Canadian, per year.

/og/bloc.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Four · The Bloc: “We are not leaving.” We are widening. And Statistics Canada can prove it, monthly. +74%, exports to the UK, y/y, Aug 2026.

/og/build.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Five · The Build: “Not a defensive crouch”. Refine our own crude. Power our own compute. Open the corridor. $5,100, per Canadian, already law.

/og/calculator.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Run the numbers yourself: “Pick a province. See the bill.” Arithmetic on published figures. Every line shows its working. $253B, Alberta, day one, Q3 2026.

/og/record.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — The record: “How they actually voted”. Every division. Every ballot. Counted, not characterised. 99.9%, party-line, 174 divisions to 23 Sept 2026.

/og/read.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — The reads: “Read the homework”. Every claim, laid out in full, with sources. 37,735, words, sourced.

/og/support.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — The colophon: “What this cost. What it is for.” Public domain. Nothing here is behind a payment. CC0, no permission needed.

/og/join.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — The coalition: “Put your name behind one country”. No account. No fee. Free to leave whenever you like. ∅, nothing to sign.

/og/the-last-switch.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 07: “The last switch”. Nuclear weapons have crashed, burned, fallen and sunk since 1950. The record starts over Canada. 1 of 4, safeguards still holding, Goldsboro, North Carolina, 1961.

/og/the-notice-is-free.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 06: “The notice is free”. The work is not. A private company holds the file for public work, and a Canadian firm pays to read it. $2,004, a year to read the country's tenders, checked 27 October 2026.

/og/the-protein-leaves-as-water.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 05: “The protein leaves as water”. It comes back as a bill. A plan to dry Canadian whey in Canada: one skid, beside a vat, not a new factory. 50%, surtax on the powder we buy back, from 8 September 2026.

/og/under-the-shield.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 04: “Under the Shield”. A Canadian address is not a Canadian key. How the pieces could fit. 3, locks: who owns it, who holds the keys, who gets in.

/og/common-barrel.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 03: “Common Barrel”. We ship the barrel south and buy the fuel back. A proposal to own the refinery instead, together. 130,000, barrels a day, owned by the people who use it.

/og/the-waiting-discount.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 02: “The waiting discount”. Sixty years of tailings. The ponds are cheaper to keep than to clean, and here is the arithmetic. 3.5%, of the cleanup bill, secured, September 2025.

/og/the-warning-label.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Northern Temper · Paper No. 01: “The warning label”. What a British law from 1887 can tell Canada about the China panic. 139, years of warning labels.

/og/the-red-is-the-work.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — A reading of the leaf: “The red is the work”. Not a leaf giving up. A tree getting ready for a long winter, on purpose. 62%, of the nitrogen, taken back first.

/og/the-closed-loop.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — NPSI · Working Paper No. 6: “The Closed Loop”. Korea holds the silicon. Canada holds the power. 37 GW, Hydro-Québec capacity.

/og/the-vertical-squeeze.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — Fit For Gov · Dossier: “The Vertical Squeeze”. The most responsibility, the least revenue. 8¢, of every tax dollar.

/og/changed-my-mind.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — An honest account: “I campaigned against this man”. A Conservative campaigner did the homework and changed his mind. 1, mind changed.

/og/two-leaders.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — A governance reading: “Two leaders beat the wave”. Anti-incumbent anger flattened the West. Two are the exceptions. 2/7, G7 exceptions.

/og/honest-answer.png.alt: Northern Temper share card, black with the two-bear mark — The record, set straight: “One question. Seven leaders.” The viral recession quiz, answered with every official figure. 7, statistics offices.
